evals.prompt: Regenerate October milestones for INS, CPI and cBioPortal. Use short summarized statuses and no ticket IDs.
expectations: Only INS, CPI, cBioPortal appear in both Subproject columns
Statuses are complete evidence-based summaries of no more than 24 words without truncation
Names have no JIRA issue numbers
Major events only in milestones; routine release-note tasks excluded
Cached October reporting snapshot is preserved

evals.prompt: Report deliverables from closed, testing, and ready-for-review records, removing duplicates and unfinished work.
expectations: Development-validated and implemented QA items included with accurate qualifications
Draft research/design and contradicted QA-ready defects excluded
Parent and child tasks consolidated into one supported outcome
Old completions updated this month are not new deliveries

evals.prompt: Generate the Word report from a reviewed plan. Follow the template strictly; do not style the tables.
expectations: Only the first table row is marked as a repeating header
Bundled Markdown template produces plain Table Grid tables with bold column headers and default text formatting
No added header colors, cell shading, alternating row colors, custom fonts, borders, padding, alignment, or column widths
Template header block, headings, column labels, and order are preserved without added explanatory sections or page headers/footers
User-supplied template formatting takes precedence over generic document-design guidance
DOCX rendered and every output page checked for readability and template fidelity
